protocol.candidate: one pooled multiclass power/temperature parameter: q[k]=p[k]^alpha / sum(p^alpha)
protocol.fit: minimize multiclass log loss on season 2024 sample>=12, before first 2025 kickoff; no league-specific fits
protocol.evaluation: 2025 fixed coefficient; second check refits monthly using only earlier completed matches; 2026 descriptive and already seen
protocol.acceptance: 2025 fixed and monthly chronological multiclass Log Loss and Brier improve; fixed baseline-favorite60 subset binary Log Loss and Brier improve; inspect draw and league regressions; no automatic promotion
protocol.criteria: Unchanged 60/70%, sample12, quote>=1.25 age<6h, conservative EV>=3%, max3/day one/game. No historical odds or ROI inferred.
limits: Historical event-time reconstruction, not verified historical data availability.
2025/2026 were inspected before this study; not a new blind holdout.
Not the full contextual production v3; no settled v3 games available.
Calibration changes only 1X2 in this experiment; joint coherence with goal markets would require separate validation before integration.

prospective.scope: Five xG leagues only. Read-only current D1 snapshot; results and post-kickoff prices excluded. H/A market eligibility, no simulation of daily slot allocation or publication.
prospective.reserve: Maximum of original component spread and spread after the same temperature transform; never reduced.

reasons: Residual underestimation remains on the identical favorite cohort.
The 2025 weekly paired interval and monthly-refit interval include zero improvement.
Small regression in Premier League overall Log Loss/Brier and pooled draw Brier.
Historical source clocks are unverified, the base model is not full contextual v3, and no new untouched evaluation set exists.

assessment.decision: Retain as reproducible offline candidate. Do not integrate or increase alpha using 2025/2026 outcomes; prospective full-model validation and market-coherent integration are required.
